detail.longDescription: It's kind of funny to see people fighting to work in the face of # ai . Part of smashing the dystopian paradigm shift is divorcing from today's obsession with 'productivity' and 'busyness' being the norm, that everyone 18+ SHOULD have a job. A lot to rethink. Not about making machines work for us but instead to rethink # work as a necessity in the first place. # noai # nogenai # genai # productivity # capitalism
